mutants.description: In S_RUN, pwm_mask takes its on-time ceiling straight from the host's max_on_limit register instead of the ceiling soft_start ramped to and now holds
mutants.reason: If the host writes a new MAX_ON_LIMIT while the converter is in S_RUN, PWM_out pulses are cut to the new limit at once. The header says the held ceiling stays until the next ramp. When a lowered limit sits between the old ceiling and the modulator's pulse width, the PWM_out pulse width changes during S_RUN.

mutants.description: The FAULT_FLAGS current-protection status bit is masked by the gate-driver enable, on the idea that the valley comparator only means something while the stage is switching
mutants.reason: While the converter is in S_OFF or S_HICCUP, or out of reset with CP_trig high (it resets high, fail-safe), an SPI read of FAULT_FLAGS returns the CP bit as 0 instead of the live synchronised comparator level.

mutants.description: The CPLD's own strike trip latch_out is ORed into the SCR read-back before debouncing, as if the read-back had to follow the CPLD's drive, so the latch read-back no longer reports only the physical SCR
mutants.reason: After strike_counter asserts latch_out, the latch status bit in reg_file reads set 1 ms later even if the latch_stat pin stays low. Until reset, the debounced latch_state also stays set whatever the pin does.
